verdict.rationale: Aider documents the pieces of this workflow. `/run` executes code and shares its output with the model, which supports reproducing an issue. `/ask` and the repo map support code questions, and community users report it locates relevant code well. `/test` plus `--test-cmd`/`--auto-test` re-run tests after edits to verify fixes. However, there is no documented workflow for narrowing down root causes (such as bisecting, tracing or debugger integration), so coverage of the full story is incomplete. missing for 10: documented root-cause isolation or debugging workflow (debugger/trace/bisect support), explicit end-to-end bug reproduction guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of fix verification.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: You can use the /run command in the chat to run your code and optionally share the output with aider.
You can configure aider to run your test suite after each time the AI edits your code using the --test-cmd <test-command> and --auto-test switch.
/ask Ask questions about the code base without editing any files.
Aider can answer questions I can't search for via LSP, like 'what code would process the following URL' and similar.
